title: 1450. Number of Students Doing Homework at a Given Time

examples.explanation: We have 3 students where: The first student started doing homework at time 1 and finished at time 3 and wasn't doing anything at time 4. The second student started doing homework at time 2 and finished at time 2 and also wasn't doing anything at time 4. The third student started doing homework at time 3 and finished at time 7 and was the only student doing homework at time 4.
The only student was doing their homework at the queryTime.
